issues.failure_explanation: The exact identity v_h = sum_l Pi^{L2}(chi_l v_h) holds only for the uncorrected pieces tilde v_{h,l}. The proof then replaces them by v_{h,l} = tilde v_{h,l} - I_h(psi_l tilde v_{h,l}), which gives sum_l v_{h,l} = v_h - sum_l I_h(psi_l tilde v_{h,l}). The correction terms are small (of size E) but nonzero, and the proof never shows they vanish or adds a remainder. So the lemma's claim v_h = sum_l v_{h,l} is not proved, and probably false. Lemma key_Garding uses this exact identity in Re a(w_h,w_h) = Re a(w_h, sum_l w_{h,l}).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: State Lemma split with a remainder r_h = v_h - sum_l v_{h,l}. Bound ||r_h||_{H^1_k} by C E ||v_h||_{L^2} using the same exponential-decay estimates summed over l with the overlap bound. Then add the term |a(w_h,r_h)| in Lemma key_Garding and absorb it using E <= C (kL)^{-1} and the existing epsilon-argument.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f-explicit splitting, the Gårding-type Lemma key_Garding, and the lower field-of-values bound of Theorem main (quasi-uniform, p_f-explicit version) are not established as written. The hp results (Theorem final1 and the GMRES corollaries) rest on them.
issues.title: Stable splitting does not sum to v_h after the boundary correction
issues.why_classification: The repair is contained: one extra remainder estimate plus one extra absorbed term. The method, rates and conclusions survive, but it needs a new estimate and edits to two lemma statements.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Given $m\geq 2$ there exists $C>0$ such that, for all $p\in\mathbb{Z}^+$ with $p_f\geq m-1$

issues.failure_explanation: Theorem interpolationMS1 is stated only for m>=2, where the point-value interpolant I_h is defined. Estimate (hope3), with the sharp factor h/p_f, invokes it with m=1. The same m=1 use appears for the residual component in the proofs of Corollaries MS1 and MS2. For m=1 the interpolant is not bounded on H^1 in d>=2. Replacing it by m=2 plus an inverse estimate loses a factor p_f, which would change the p_f-dependence in (hope1).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Extend Theorem interpolationMS1 to m=1 for piecewise-polynomial or smooth arguments, or redo (hope3) using only m>=2 estimates and check that the final p_f-power survives.
issues.overall_effect: The p_f^2 factor in the stable splitting (through (hope1)-(hope3)) is not justified by the cited theorem.
issues.title: Interpolation theorem used with m=1 although stated only for m>=2
issues.why_classification: The fix is local: a clarification of the cited estimate for piecewise polynomials, or a short recomputation. The result and scaling are expected to survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Theorem LSW3 bounds the H^2 part by k^{-|alpha|}||d^alpha u_{H^2}|| <= C_1 k^{-1} Csol ||f||. Interpolating it in H^1_k or H^2_k therefore gives (kh/p_f) times Csol/(kL) (or Csol/(kL) for H^2_k), not (kh/p_f) or 1. The stated bounds in Cor MS1, Cor MS2 and (Bristol3)/(milk2) omit this factor. Csol >= C kL, so the factor is bounded only in the nontrapping case Csol ~ kL. For merely polynomially bounded Csol it can grow like (kL)^{P-1}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the factor Csol/(kL) in the first terms of Cor MS1/MS2 and in (Bristol3)/(milk2). Then either restrict to nontrapping Csol <~ kL, or tighten the mesh conditions (e.g. H <= c L/(Lambda Csol)) and restate the coarse-space dimensions accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: Under only polynomial bounds on Csol, the conditions H <= c/(k Lambda) (Theorem final1) and the conditions in Theorem final2 do not guarantee small eta(V_0). Case (c) and the claimed coarse dimensions are unsupported beyond the nontrapping case.
issues.title: H^2-component interpolation bounds drop the factor Csol/(kL), which breaks the claimed regime H~1/k for polynomially bounded Csol
issues.why_classification: The nontrapping case survives unchanged. For the general polynomial case a limited weakening (a stronger H-condition) is needed, which changes the advertised coarse dimension for trapping-type Csol but leaves the method intact.

issues.failure_explanation: The statement covers every p_f >= 1 + Cdegree log k, with no upper bound. The proof bounds (Csol/(kL)) ((h/L)/(h/L+sigma))^{p_f} by C (kL)^{P-1-p_f} (p_f c)^{p_f}, then substitutes p_f = 1 + Cdegree log(kL). That substitution is valid only if (p_f c/(kL))^{p_f} is decreasing in p_f, which fails once p_f c >~ kL. For such p_f, h is only constrained by kh/p_f <= C_1, so h can be comparable to L, the ratio (h/L)/(h/L+sigma) is not small, and the term Csol/(kL)(...)^{p_f} is not small. So the bound eta <= epsilon/Ccont is not shown for all p_f.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add an upper bound p_f <= cC(1 + Cdegree log(kL)) (or a lower bound on h) to Corollary MS3, or add the monotonicity argument for the allowed range of p_f.
issues.overall_effect: The 'for all p_f' claim of Corollary MS3 is unsupported at large p_f. Theorem final1 is unaffected, since it restricts p_f <= cC(1 + Cdegree log(kL)).
issues.title: Corollary MS3 claimed for all p_f but proof evaluates at p_f = 1 + Cdegree log(kL)
issues.why_classification: Adding a standard range restriction already used in Theorem final1 fixes it, and no downstream result is lost.
